meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 帮您把旧版 NanoClaw 迁移到新版的收尾工作做完:先查迁移报告,修复失败步骤,让新版能正常收发消息后,把您设为管理员,迁移聊天记忆和容器配置,处理旧版自定义代码,最后检查并重启服务。
howto.when: 当您提到“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 迁移”等说法,并且已经运行过 bash migrate-v2.sh,该技能会接管收尾工作。

say.text: 继续完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾
say.note: 开始检查迁移报告并继续后续步骤。

say.text: 把陌生人访问策略改为仅已知用户
say.note: 会让你确认哪些用户可导入并更新设置。

say.text: 我 v1 里有一些自定义改动,帮我看怎么处理
say.note: 会列出改动清单给你选择处理方式。

howto.what_en: Finishes the manual NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: checks the handoff report, fixes failed steps, verifies v2 handles messages, seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, ports custom code, then verifies and restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration', after bash migrate-v2.sh has completed. It takes over the remaining manual steps from the handoff report.

say_en.text: Continue the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Checks the handoff report and keeps going.

say_en.text: Set the access policy to known users only.
say_en.note: Confirms the user list and updates the policy.

say_en.text: I have custom v1 code. How should I handle it?
say_en.note: Lists your commits and offers handling options.
